research_question: Can the WP01 eight-dimensional positive weight quotient be reconstructed exactly from cycle/path invariants of a qualified C05 embedding?

geometry_only_result.reason: The other five invariant directions are boundary-to-boundary paths. Their monomials retain branch endpoint factors beta_i, and no geometry-only recovery of those factors has been established.

calibrated_result.requires: C05 algebraic branch boundary factors beta_i in addition to embedding increments
calibrated_result.interpretation: With branch boundary calibration, all eight gauge-invariant weight coordinates are exactly reconstructed and converted to/from the WP01 chart by a unimodular monomial map.

falsification.hypothesis: all eight quotient directions arise as closed-cycle geometry invariants
falsification.exact_reason: The connected full graph has cycle rank 16-14+1=3. The remaining five gauge-invariant directions necessarily carry boundary flow.

terminal_statement: WP05 establishes an exact three-dimensional geometry-only cycle reconstruction and an exact eight-dimensional path+cycle reconstruction when the certified branch boundary factors are supplied. It does not establish a full geometry-only inverse because five boundary-path directions retain branch endpoint calibration.
next_research_boundary: Determine whether the five boundary factors beta_i can themselves be recovered canonically from the admitted embedding geometry, without consuming the algebraic branch witness or the known quotient.
